csv_project_name: Design for Public Address System Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: The Orange County Sanitation District seeking information from qualified consultants for the upcoming J-141 Public Address System Replacement Project and invites interested firms to participate in this early market outreach effort. Design Services for the Public Address System Replacement. This project will implement a new PA system, expand the fiber and network infrastructure at Reclamation Plant Nos. 1 and 2, and expand to seven coastal pump stations. The upgrade will replace the aging system, which no longer meets operational needs due to limited coverage and outdated functionality. The new PA system will leverage Ethernet/IP-based technology and will be fully integrated with OC SAN s existing emergency communication platforms, including mass notification systems, to enhance reliability, scalability, and safety.
